svg.title: In the workshop: products in development
svg.desc: Tunic Screen Recorder: Screen Studio-grade recording for Windows: automatic zooms, smooth cursor, GPU export. Local-first. TunisAPI: A directory and gateway for Tunisian APIs, with first-party APIs where local data is missing. Alabrain: A private memory of my computer work that my AI agents query over MCP, with every answer citing its sources. Northstar: Keeps a project’s vision, roadmap and verified progress, so any coding agent can pick up where the last one stopped.
svg.text: Products I am building now in private repositories. They go public, or on sale, when they are ready.
